tools.purpose: PySide6<6.9, Pillow, numpy<2.3, mss, imageio, imageio-ffmpeg, keyboard
tools.install: pip install -r requirements.txt (Windows build also: pyinstaller)
bundled by imageio-ffmpeg (no system install needed)
apt-get install -y libegl1 libgl1 libxkbcommon0 libfontconfig1 libdbus-1-3

tools.purpose: tag/push/release watch from the USER PC (gh run watch, gh release view, gh issue)
tools.fallback: GitHub MCP connector for reads/PRs/issues; pushing a tag that triggers release.yml needs git+gh credentials on the user PC

tools.purpose: runs wrangler (relay deploy) and REA MCP
deploy relay/ Cloudflare Worker (crash reports -> GitHub issues)
notes: login: npx wrangler login (browser; user must Allow)
GITHUB_TOKEN is a Worker secret: npx wrangler secret put GITHUB_TOKEN (fine-grained, Baegovda/BongGIF only, Issues RW)
never commit secrets; KV id in wrangler.toml is not secret
deploy: cd relay && npx wrangler deploy

mcp_servers.purpose: read repo, issues (auto-report label), PRs, Actions status
mcp_servers.install: host connector, or docs/mcp.example.json 'github' (ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server, PAT env)

mcp_servers.purpose: OPTIONAL reverse-engineering MCP for studying the reference app's behavior only. CLEAN-ROOM: never copy decompiled logic, assets, names or UI text into the repo.
install: npx rea-agents setup   (interactive; or: npx -y rea-agents@6.7.0 setup --yes --client <cursor|claude|...>)
MCP entry: command npx, args [-y, rea-agents@6.7.0, mcp] (see docs/mcp.example.json)

providers.ilspy: dotnet tool install -g ilspycmd -> REA_ILSPY_CMD_PATH, DOTNET_ROOT
providers.others: apktool, adb, wabt, wakaru, mitmdump, tshark, sigrok, pwndbg via REA_* env (only if installed)

mcp_servers.verify: npx -y rea-agents@6.7.0 doctor  ;  npx -y rea-agents@6.7.0 providers
mcp_servers.fallback: skip; not needed to build, test or release

user_pc.policy: winget/MSI installs may be blocked by org policy -> use portable/zip packages, no admin
user_pc.repo_clone: %USERPROFILE%\BongGIF (git + gh logged in; publishing happens here)
user_pc.installed_app: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\BongGIF (owner tests self-update; agents must NOT touch it)

secrets: none in repo. Worker secret GITHUB_TOKEN lives only in Cloudflare.
